name: Dorm Cooling
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Put cash inside the fridge to upgrade it.
Give the cold cola from the fridge to the sweating boy.
Open the window curtains for fresh air.
Tap the air conditioner twice to increase cooling.
Use the hair trimmer to cut the boy’s long hair.
Tap the boy on the lower bunk to remove his winter jacket.
